destinations.name: UCH Main Gate (Oritamefa)
destinations.accessNotes: Primary public and vehicular entrance on Queen Elizabeth II Road. 24/7 security checkpoint, pedestrian turnstiles and vehicle boom gates.
destinations.description: The iconic main gateway to University College Hospital, connecting the hospital to Queen Elizabeth II Road, Total Garden, and central Ibadan.

destinations.name: UCH East Gate (School of Nursing Road)
destinations.accessNotes: East entrance off Queen Elizabeth II Road / School of Nursing Road, providing direct access to nursing residences, schools, and eastern wards.
destinations.description: Secondary public entrance facilitating patient and staff access to educational institutions and residences.

sources.name: Waze Nigeria UCH East Gate Navigation

destinations.name: Accident & Emergency (A&E) Department
destinations.accessNotes: Ground floor dedicated casualty ambulance drop-off ramp on the southern frontage of the central ward block. Open 24 hours.
destinations.description: The primary emergency care center of UCH, receiving acute adult and surgical trauma, medical emergencies, and resuscitation cases.

destinations.name: Main Hospital Complex (Central Ward Block)
destinations.accessNotes: Main hospital entrance hall on ground floor; central lift bank and ramps access inpatient wards (Floors 1-6).
destinations.description: The architectural centerpiece of UCH: the landmark 6-story modernist inpatient hospital commissioned in November 1957 by Queen Elizabeth II. Features distinctive concrete sunshade louvers (brise-soleil) and multi-tier ward fingers.

destinations.name: East Clinical Ward Block
destinations.accessNotes: Connected to central ward spine via covered pedestrian corridors.
destinations.description: Inpatient surgical and medical specialty wards occupying the eastern finger of the primary ward structure.

destinations.name: West Clinical Ward Block
destinations.accessNotes: Accessible from central spine and western perimeter road.
destinations.description: Multi-tier ward wing housing obstetric, gynaecological, and paediatric inpatient services.

destinations.name: Chief Tony Anenih Geriatric Centre (CTAGC)
destinations.accessNotes: Ramp access on Queen Elizabeth Road approach frontage, purpose-built for elderly and mobility-impaired patients.
destinations.description: The pioneer purpose-built geriatric medical center in West Africa, inaugurated in November 2012. Specializes in comprehensive holistic care for seniors aged 60 and above.

sources.name: Chief Tony Anenih Geriatric Centre Monograph

destinations.name: Otunba Tunwase Children's Emergency Ward (OTCHEW)
destinations.accessNotes: Paediatric emergency bay with dedicated triage and stabilization room on the south clinic frontage.
destinations.description: Endowed paediatric emergency ward established through Otunba Subomi Balogun, providing intensive emergency medical treatment for infants and children.

destinations.name: Department of Radiation Oncology
destinations.accessNotes: Accessed via the Radiation Oncology service road off the central hospital spine.
destinations.description: Nigeria's premier cancer radiotherapy facility, equipped with teletherapy, brachytherapy suites, and treatment simulation facilities.

sources.name: UCH Department of Radiotherapy / Radiation Oncology

destinations.name: Department of Nuclear Medicine (Afe Babalola Building)
destinations.accessNotes: Located inside the Afe Babalola diagnostic complex adjacent to Radiation Oncology.
destinations.description: Specialized radioactive isotope diagnostic imaging (SPECT/PET-CT) and radionuclide therapy services.

sources.name: College of Medicine UI - Nuclear Medicine

destinations.name: UCH Central & Outpatient Pharmacy
destinations.accessNotes: Ground floor dispensary windows on outpatient concourse.
destinations.description: Main hospital pharmacy dispensing outpatient prescriptions, compounded medications, and clinical pharmaceutical supplies.

destinations.name: Department of Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
destinations.accessNotes: Located in the Faculty of Clinical Sciences sector with gymnasium and hydrotherapy access.
destinations.description: Comprehensive physical medicine, neuro-rehabilitation, orthopaedic rehabilitation, and electrotherapy facilities.

sources.name: Nigeria Society of Physiotherapy - UCH Chapter

destinations.name: Paul Hendrickse Lecture Theatre
destinations.accessNotes: Tiered lecture theatre entrance on College of Medicine plaza adjacent to E. Latunde Odeku Library.
destinations.description: Historical central academic lecture auditorium of the College of Medicine, University of Ibadan, named after pioneering obstetrician Professor Paul Hendrickse.

sources.name: College of Medicine, University of Ibadan (CoMUI)

destinations.name: College of Medicine, University of Ibadan (Administration)
destinations.accessNotes: Administrative office complex with Provost's office, Faculty deans, and academic registry.
destinations.description: Administrative headquarters of the College of Medicine, University of Ibadan, situated within the UCH campus perimeter.

destinations.name: Alexander Brown Hall (ABH)
destinations.accessNotes: Accessed via Alexander Brown Hostel Road off the central ring road. Security turnstile for registered clinical students.
destinations.description: The official residential hall for clinical medical, dental, and health sciences students of the University of Ibadan.

destinations.name: UCH Central Mosque
destinations.accessNotes: Worship ground with ablution facilities situated on the northeastern residential quadrant.
destinations.description: Community place of worship serving Muslim patients, visitors, and hospital staff.

destinations.name: School of Nursing & Midwifery
destinations.accessNotes: Accessed via School of Nursing Road near East Gate. Specific classroom vs hostel pavilion footprint assignment is currently under review in the map workspace.
destinations.description: One of Nigeria's premier institutions for general nursing and basic midwifery education, situated in the eastern academic and residential sector of UCH.

sources.name: UCH Schools of Nursing & Midwifery Directory
